65:   }

68:    * Create a primitive containing a character. The character is turned into a one character String

70:    *
71:    * @param c the value to create the primitive with.
72:    */

74:   public JsonPrimitive(Character c) {

82:    *
83:    * @since 2.8.2
84:    */
85:   @Override

276:       return true;
277:     }
278:     if (obj == null) {
279:       return false;
280:     }
281:     if (!(obj instanceof JsonElement)) {

283:     }

287:     }

292:       return otherValue == null;
293:     }
294:     if (otherValue == null) {
295:       return false;
296:     }

298:     Class<?> thisType = thisValue.getClass();
299:     Class<?> otherType = otherValue.getClass();
300:     Class<?> thisWrapped = Primitives.wrap(thisType);
301:     Class<?> otherWrapped = Primitives.wrap(otherType);
302:     Class<?> thisUnwrapped = Primitives.unwrap(thisWrapped);
303:     Class<?> otherUnwrapped = Primitives.unwrap(otherWrapped);
304:     boolean thisIsNumber = thisValue instanceof Number;
305:     boolean otherIsNumber = otherValue instanceof Number;
306:     boolean thisIntegral = isIntegral(this);
307:     boolean otherIntegral = isIntegral(other);
308: 
309:     if (thisIntegral) {
310:       if (otherIntegral) {
311:         String thisRaw;
312:         long thisLong;
313:         if (thisUnwrapped == long.class) {
314:           Number thisNumberValue = (Number) thisValue;
315:           long thisPrimitiveLong = thisNumberValue.longValue();
316:           thisRaw = Long.toString(thisPrimitiveLong);
317:         } else {
318:           String thisOriginal = thisValue.toString();
319:           StringBuilder thisRawBuilder = new StringBuilder(thisOriginal.length());
320:           thisRawBuilder.append(thisOriginal);
321:           thisRaw = thisRawBuilder.toString();
322:         }
323:         try {
324:           thisLong = Long.parseLong(thisRaw);
325:         } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
326:           BigDecimal thisDecimal = new BigDecimal(thisRaw);
327:           thisLong = thisDecimal.toBigInteger().longValue();
328:         }

331:         long otherLong;
332:         if (otherUnwrapped == long.class) {
333:           Number otherNumberValue = (Number) otherValue;
334:           long otherPrimitiveLong = otherNumberValue.longValue();
335:           otherRaw = Long.toString(otherPrimitiveLong);
336:         } else {
337:           String otherOriginal = otherValue.toString();
338:           StringBuilder otherRawBuilder = new StringBuilder(otherOriginal.length());
339:           otherRawBuilder.append(otherOriginal);
340:           otherRaw = otherRawBuilder.toString();
341:         }
342:         try {
343:           otherLong = Long.parseLong(otherRaw);
344:         } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
345:           BigDecimal otherDecimal = new BigDecimal(otherRaw);

349:       }
350:     }

360:         boolean otherNaN = Double.isNaN(b);
